GM CT

@elenism good morning, please can I get a "GM" from you queen

DIMO Partnership for Smart Cities

In Oct 2025 @openmind_agi teamed up with DIMO to bring decentralized identity and permissions to city robot fleets

Every OM1 robot now carries a verifiable DIMO ID linked to its on chain reputation
This lets buildings roads and vehicles grant or remove access in real time

A delivery bot enters an apartment lobby on its own
A hospital humanoid gets clearance for restricted wards
No human approval needed

First rollouts are live in Manila and Seoul with over 200 robots using DIMO credentials for elevator access gated communities and traffic priority

This is the base layer for permissionless smart city robotics in 2026

data.raw_text: We are currently at the UN Land Convention (UNCCD) implementation reviews (CRIC23) in Panama City, bringing up local issues to the global stage. 🇵🇭🌏 From the global perspective, it is clear that the shift to renewable energy cannot come at the cost of further land degradation and biodiversity loss. 🤚 Under this international agreement, the Philippines committed to achieve Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) in 60% of forest land, shrublands and wetlands by 2030. 📈 There are currently 197 parties/signatory states to the convention, with the Philippines well-positioned to play a bigger role due to the obvious need and opportunity for sustainable land use and management in the face of extreme flooding and drought. 📢 #SaveMasungi #RestoreTogether @UNCCD
